Our Team Members | AVSC Veterinary Staff
Meet the dedicated veterinary technicians, client service representatives, and support staff at Advanced Veterinary Specialty Center in Walpole, MA.

Our team consists of dedicated individuals who are knowledgeable, kind and caring. All pets deserve the greatest quality of life that is medically possible. We are committed to treating your pet as we would our own, with the gentle care they deserve.
